headline: What this system measured, and what it has not.

items.label: Damaged parts found
items.detail: labelled damaged parts on 41 public photos, mostly non-Indian cars and wide shots
items.caveat: labels by Claude by eye; the photos were also used for design choices

items.label: Parts never outlined
items.caveat: retraining on 4,937 more images (Run 3) and running at other image sizes moved found parts only from 22 to at most 25

items.label: Silent misses inside an offer
items.caveat: a labelled damaged part missed in a claim that still ended in an OFFER: the offer under-pays by it

items.label: Offers on the dev photos
items.caveat: none of the 6 on damaged cars found every labelled damaged part; 1 was on a car with no labelled damage; 7 claims is an anecdote

items.label: Unseen photos
items.caveat: 5 asked for more, 3 went to a human, 1 to a surveyor; 3 of the 3 human routes were plate mismatches against simulated policies

items.label: Per-panel crop detection
items.detail: none of the 22 lost and silent misses 8 to 0, but photos with a false-alarm part 1 to 3 of 6 and OFFER claims 7 to 2 (41 photos)
items.caveat: failed the pre-set false-alarm rule (+33 percentage points); not adopted, off by default

items.label: Video path
items.detail: plus 1 control and 9 vision tests, on synthetic clips (generated textures, 2 clips from the teammate)
items.caveat: implemented and tested on synthetic cases; not validated on real walk-around video

items.label: Money logic
items.detail: scripted attacks on the claim flow plus 1 control; 48 unit tests including a 5,000-claim fuzz
items.caveat: shows these attacks fail, not that none exist; tests written against the same code

items.label: Prices
items.detail: part prices are listed MRPs (151 rate-card rows)
items.caveat: other-generation and similar-car prices are IMPUTED; Creta front bumper cover ₹2,402 incl. tax matches boodmo (Run 3 spot check, one page)

items.label: Garage quotes read by the model
items.value: 45 of 53 lines exact, 15 of 15 grand totals
items.caveat: synthetic printed quotes only; handwritten quotes not measured

not_measured: Accuracy on real Indian claim photos at scale
Severity accuracy (no public dataset labels severity)
Handwritten garage quotes and real garage invoices
